name: A01_2_only_creature_spells_with_flying_cost_less
notes: Printed: 'Creature spells with flying you cast cost {1} less to cast.' Two Islands are all seat 0 has. Mystic Skyfish ({2}{U}, a 3/1 with no flying) is not reduced: it costs its full three mana and the two Islands cannot pay it (the cast is refused, nothing is tapped). Mistral Singer ({2}{U}, printed flying), cast next in the same window, costs {1}{U} and is paid by the same two Islands. The refusal is no timing fault: the Singer is cast in the same main phase.
